reason: A click-to-source inspector for local frontend development pages that identifies the corresponding Vue, React, Svelte, or Angular source location and places it in the DSH chat draft for optional follow-up.

summaries.zh: 在本地前端开发页面中点击任意界面元素，定位其对应的 Vue、React、Svelte 或 Angular 源文件与行号，并将结果填入 DSH 聊天草稿。
summaries.en: Click an element in a local frontend development page to locate its Vue, React, Svelte, or Angular source file and line, then place the result in the DSH chat draft.

capabilities: Previews local development pages through a plugin-hosted proxy
Injects a probe to inspect clicked UI element metadata
Resolves clicked elements to source files and approximate lines within the session workspace
Reads source context for display and populates the DSH chat composer draft
Can optionally steer or wake the agent after a selection when configured
